# 75452 - Dual peripheral driver (75452B)

Package DIP-8 · family 754xx · catalogue file [catalog/chips/75452.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/75452.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 45 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![75452 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/75452.png) | ![75452 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-75452.png) | ![75452 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-75452.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8 | VCC | power |  | +5 V |
| 4 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 1 | 1A | input |  |  |
| 2 | 1B | input |  |  |
| 6 | 2A | input |  |  |
| 7 | 2B | input |  |  |
| 3 | 1Y | output | open-collector-high-voltage |  |
| 5 | 2Y | output | open-collector-high-voltage |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3,5 | Y = NOT (A AND B) | Positive-NAND: output transistor on (low) only when A and B are both high; otherwise off (high, external pull-up). |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputMaxVoltageV | 30 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | VCC 4.75-5.25 V, TA 0-70 C. Abs max output voltage 30 V, output current 300 mA. Off-state IOH max 100 uA at VOH 30 V. VOL 0.25/0.4 V at 100 mA, 0.5/0.7 V at 300 mA. Inputs VIH 2 V, VIL 0.8 V, IIL -1.6 mA. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, IO ~200 mA, CL 15 pF, RL 50 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A or B | Y | PLH | 26 | 35 |
| A or B | Y | PHL | 24 | 35 |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin |
|---|---|
| transitionTime | Y |

## Not known

- Recommended operating conditions give no output current; only the 300 mA absolute maximum and the 100/300 mA VOL test points are printed, so IOL is null.
- No minimum delays printed.

## Sources

- [TI The Interface Circuits Data Book 2nd ed. 1974, Series 55450B/75450B dual peripheral drivers (bulletin DL-S 7311798, Sep 1973, tentative data sheet)](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1974_TI_The_Interface_Data_Book_for_Design_Engineers_Second_Edition.pdf) - 6-42, 6-43, 6-51 (PDF pages 272, 273, 281); SN75452B (page titled 'TYPE SN75452')
